cases.question: Which encounter types have the most substance use screening procedure records in 2020?

attempts.plan: Filter procedures to code 713106006 with START in UTC [2020-01-01, 2021-01-01). Count raw procedure records (not distinct patients) grouped by the linked encounter's ENCOUNTERCLASS, joining procedures.ENCOUNTER to encounters.Id and matching PATIENT IDs. Report record counts and distinct patients, sorted by record count descending.
attempts.sql: SELECT e.ENCOUNTERCLASS AS encounter_class, COUNT(*) AS screening_procedure_records, COUNT(DISTINCT p.PATIENT) AS distinct_patients FROM procedures AS p JOIN encounters AS e ON p.ENCOUNTER = e.Id AND p.PATIENT = e.PATIENT WHERE p.CODE = '713106006' AND CAST(p.START AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= CAST('2020-01-01 00:00:00+00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND CAST(p.START AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < CAST('2021-01-01 00:00:00+00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY e.ENCOUNTERCLASS ORDER BY screening_procedure_records DESC LIMIT 20

cases.question: Which disorder-labeled condition descriptions had the most distinct patients with a new record in 2019? Show the top 5.

attempts.plan: Filter conditions to descriptions containing '(disorder)' and START within UTC calendar year 2019 [2019-01-01, 2020-01-01). Count distinct patients per description (new records in the year, not active-overlap). Rank top 5. Note: '(disorder)' label is a text heuristic only and does not mean the description covers all diseases.
attempts.sql: SELECT DESCRIPTION AS condition_description, COUNT(DISTINCT PATIENT) AS distinct_patients FROM conditions WHERE DESCRIPTION ILIKE '%(disorder)%' AND CAST(START AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= CAST('2019-01-01 00:00:00+00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND CAST(START AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < CAST('2020-01-01 00:00:00+00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY DESCRIPTION ORDER BY distinct_patients DESC, condition_description ASC LIMIT 5
